notes: Max-level XP-to-money uses the base quest XP evaluated at max level after quest-level decay/rounding; the server leveling XP multiplier is not applied.
The current server policy uses max(reward_money_copper, xp_conversion_copper), based on project live-server evidence; AzerothCore default core behavior is not treated as the server policy source.
QUEST_FLAGS_NO_MONEY_FROM_XP is 0x100 in WotLK 3.3.5a sources and must be present as a structural Task Card reward fact before a max-level turn-in can be fresh.
